architect.rationale: Smallest meaningful delta from a 16-crate plan. KekId + DekId are the foundational identifiers — nothing in the envelope encryption or signing stacks can land without them. Adding to the existing oya-cloud-kms-domain crate (which already owns KmsKeyId, KmsPurpose, CloudKmsError) is the correct merge-variant home. Follows identical validation pattern to existing types.

guardrails: KekId and DekId are slug-prefixed identifiers, not UUID-typed. The P08 impl-plan SQL schema uses uuid PRIMARY KEY for key_id. Future slices that bridge KekId/DekId to the DB row must resolve this impedance (slug vs UUID); captured as a note for the next P08 delta.

The remaining P08 envelope primitives (ZeroizingBytes, CipherTextBlob, RotationReport, AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt) require the aes-gcm and zeroize crates as dependencies — those Cargo.toml additions are out of scope for this identifier-only slice and belong in the next delta.
InMemoryKmsAdapter must remain cfg(test)-only per the plan; this slice does not introduce it, but future slices must enforce that gate.
